summary.en: Installs a durable tracing spine (docs/changes + PRD/design snapshots + changelog + decision log) plus AGENTS.md and hooks so important agent-driven changes are recorded and kept from drifting.
summary.zh: 一次性安装可持续的追踪骨架（docs/changes + PRD/设计活文档快照 + changelog + 决策日志）以及 AGENTS.md 和 hooks，让智能体驱动的 SDLC 重要变更被记录、跟踪，并在持续开发中不跑偏。
